subject: HorizonEdge pilot: request for promotional concession (credits + discount)
messages:
From: Samir Patel <samir.patel@horizonedge.io>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Cc: Elena Morris <emorris@horizonedge.io>
Date: Wed, 25 Apr 2028 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot run and request for additional credits + pricing consideration

Hi Karthik,

Thanks again for walking us through the Redwood demo last week — team was impressed with the latency profile on our sample prompts. We kicked off the initial pilot and have a couple of asks before we scale:

- Can you extend our 30-day trial to 90 days? We still need to validate integration with our data pipelines.
- We consumed the initial allotment faster than expected; would Redwood consider a one-time top-up of 200k token credits to finish data ingestion tests?
- Finally, we are evaluating annual pricing. Is a 20% first-year discount negotiable if we commit to a 12-month reserved capacity after pilot?

Attached: HorizonEdge_SOW_v1.pdf (SOW draft), sample-ingest.log (referenced). Procurement may also have documentation requests — looping them in.

Appreciate any flexibility — we want to move quickly if terms make sense.

Thanks,
Samir
VP Product, HorizonEdge

> Thanks again for walking us through ...
> - extend trial to 90 days
> - 200k token top-up

Samir — appreciate the clear asks. I think there's a path here but need a quick internal approval for a combo concession. High level proposal I'm putting forward:

- One-time 200k token credit top-up for pilot (apply as prepaid credits on account)
- Extend pilot to 90 days (no additional charge)
- Conditional approval of up to 15% off year-one list for a 12-month reserved commit; anything beyond 15% needs exec sign-off

Marissa / Neha — can you weigh in on whether we can stretch to 20% if we bundle the credits and lock a 12-month minimal ARR? If so, please prepare a short exec ask (numbers + rationale). Samir, if you can confirm expected ARR post-commit, that will help speed review.

Karthik Iyer
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
From: neha_kapoor@redwood.ai
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Cc: jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 01 May 2028 11:18:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: HorizonEdge pilot - concession matrix + recommendation

Team — I ran the numbers and drafted a short concession matrix (attached: HE-deal-summary.xlsx). Key points:

- ARR upside: HorizonEdge has indicated ~$240k ARR if they move to a 12-month reserved plan after pilot (conservative).
- CAC / incentive: 200k token credit = ~$6.5k TCO units (based on current token pricing); 3-month extension reduces churn risk and improves chance of commit.
- Discount sensitivity: 15% keeps economics within our standard discount band for mid-market; 20% would reduce first-year GP by ~7 percentage points vs list.

Recommendation: Approve credit top-up + trial extension now. For discount, recommend we offer 15% as default and request exec approval only if we are to go to 20% or include additional technical support hours free.

If we want to push for 20% we should get an executive exception that includes: a signed 12-month reserved commit, minimum ARR clause ($150k), and a reciprocity clause (case study / reference).

Neha Kapoor
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
To: jonas_weber@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, neha_kapoor@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 02 May 2028 15:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Exec approval request — HorizonEdge promotional concession (credits + discount)

Jonas — quick ask for sign-off. Below is the proposed executive exception for HorizonEdge (deal HE-2028-042):

Proposed concession (one-time exception):
- 200k token credit top-up applied during pilot (one-time, non-recurring)
- Pilot extension to 90 days (no additional fee)
- 20% off list for year one, conditioned on a signed 12-month reserved capacity contract with minimum ARR of $150k and a case study commitment.

Rationale: HorizonEdge is strategic in the fintech data pipeline vertical; low friction integration and short ramp expected. They signaled strong intent to commit if the economics align. Expected first-year contracted revenue (post-discount): ~$192k. The credit cost and extension are small relative to the expected LTV and will materially increase probability of conversion.

Risk / controls:
- Credit is one-time and expires at the end of pilot; not applied to future invoices.
- Discount applies only to year-one reserved capacity charges, not to overage or additional add-ons.
- Require signed DocuSign with minimum ARR clause and clause for clawback if case study not granted.

Attachments: HE-deal-summary.xlsx, Redwood-promos-2028.pdf

Request: Approve the above exception (20% band) or advise a counter (e.g., 15% + 10 dev hours). Need response by EOD Monday to keep the procurement window open.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Director, Sales Operations | Redwood Inference
From: jonas_weber@redwood.ai
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, neha_kapoor@redwood.ai; Samir Patel <samir.patel@horizonedge.io>, Elena Morris <emorris@horizonedge.io>, procurement@horizonedge.io
Date: Fri, 09 May 2028 16:22:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Exec approval request — HorizonEdge promotional concession (credits + discount)

Marissa / team — thanks for the concise packet. I approve the exception with one amendment: swap the 20% flat discount for 18% off year-one list plus one dedicated onboarding support block (up to 20 hours) to ensure they hit production in Q3. All other controls stand (one-time credit, signed 12-month reserved contract, minimum ARR $150k, case study clause, and clawback).

Karthik — please confirm acceptance with HorizonEdge and route the DocuSign to procurement with the updated terms. Samir / Elena — happy to move forward on this path if you can sign the 12-month reserved commitment and the case study agreement. I will ask Legal to review the DocuSign template immediately.

Jonas Weber
VP Sales | Redwood Inference
